offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures structural connectors, anchors, fasteners and construction adhesives for wood and concrete buildings. Sells mainly to builders, contractors and engineers through lumber dealers, distributors and home centers, and makes the products in its own plants.

primary_products.value: structural connectors; concrete and masonry anchors; fasteners; construction adhesives; concrete repair products

customer_segment.value: B2B: home builders, framing contractors, lumber dealers, structural engineers, do-it-yourself home improvers via retail

end_markets.value: residential construction; commercial construction; home improvement; infrastructure

revenue_model.value: product sales: connectors, anchors, fasteners and adhesives sold to dealers, distributors and builders

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes connectors and anchors from steel and other raw materials, sold to dealers and contractors; brand owner: designs and markets its own branded building products sold through distribution and retail

geography_served.value: global: US and Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, with plants in several countries

specialization.value: related lines: structural connectors, anchors, fasteners, adhesives and concrete repair products sharing construction customers

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: lumber dealers and building material distributors; third-party retail: home center retail chains; direct sales: national accounts with large builders and contractors; online: online sales of products to contractors and consumers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building code approvals and product testing reports for connectors and anchors, plus workplace safety and environmental rules for manufacturing
